description: The syncs of a report other than a SlideDeck, such as a Google Slides presentation or an email report: each chart, table or text it pulls from a source, with how it did the last time it updated and why it failed. Pass the failed ones' ids as `syncIds` to `startReportRun` to update only those. A SlideDeck report has datasheets instead and returns `400`.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

name: listReportSyncs
title: List report syncs
